findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: AGENTS.md:573 and packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:59 instruct Agents to record through or trigger an authoritative Dynamic Finding applicability/history path as if it were available now. The authoritative plan is explicitly specification-only and future implementation (dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:3-6,59-68,909-967), while the approved proposal requires a compatibility-only disposition before that system exists (sections 7-9) and says historical correction/supersession is used only when available. Omitting that temporal boundary makes all five REVIEW prompts and the Story Owner guidance promise unavailable structured authority, risking fabricated fields/evidence or an impossible workflow; this directly violates CHK-002 adversarial:4 and the no-undelivered-command/field acceptance. severity=critical

packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-registry-smoke.ts:83 quality-test-gap (medium): the focused triage semantic test only asserts required phrases are present (lines 83-106, 137-139) and has no forbidden/contradictory-permission assertions or mutation cases. Appending inverse prose such as reviewer may call gap_log/finding_dismiss, dismissal proves out_of_scope, severity alone decides scope, or old reviewRunId evidence remains valid would leave every focused assertion green (and deliberate digest repins would also green the baselines). This fails CHK-001 adversarial:2/3/4/5 and CHK-004 adversarial:semantic-collapse/test-weakening, which require semantic validation to reject those inverse cases rather than only prove the happy wording exists.

concept-cleanup: CLAUDE.md:783-784 still contains the exact superseded unbounded-scope rules: proactively fix discovered issues instead of saying out of scope, and repair cross-Story infrastructure bugs together instead of leaving them to a later Story. AGENTS.md:571-573 now says the opposite bounded current-Story/evidence-backed routing contract. Because CLAUDE.md is the active Claude host guide, the replacement is incomplete and host behavior diverges: Claude is still instructed to expand scope while Codex is instructed not to. This violates the cross-host Agent behavior outcome and the proposal current-scope boundary. severity=critical

packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:51,58 preserves the Dynamic Finding verdict names but weakens their minimum evidence semantics. Compared with dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:824-835 and the approved proposal section 4, pre_existing_unaffected omits deterministic base/head reproduction plus no-worsening proof; out_of_scope omits signed scope/decision evidence and acceptance non-contradiction; duplicate omits a signature-valid live canonical Finding/owner and no-cycle requirement; stale_or_not_reproduced omits current command receipts with source/runtime freshness and the prohibition on inferring from old DONE. General source-or-command evidence at line 44 does not preserve these verdict-specific thresholds. The gate remains machine-owned, but all five reviewers are taught to propose under-evidenced routing candidates, violating CHK-001/CHK-004 distinct-outcome and current-evidence acceptance. severity=high
